\documentclass[11pt]{article}\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}\usepackage{amsmath,amsthm}\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}\newtheorem{remark}{Remark}
\title{Dispersion-Aware Finite-Time Conditional Optimization}\author{}\date{21 July 2026}\begin{document}\maketitle
\begin{abstract}We replace the worst-case max-radius parameter by exact staple Fr\'echet dispersion and obtain a strictly feasible low-dispersion conditional channel.\end{abstract}
Let $C_*$ minimize $\sum_i d(C,S_i)^2=\mathcal D$.  If $d(C,C_*)\le\delta$, Minkowski's inequality in $\ell^2$ gives
\[\left(\sum_i d(C,S_i)^2\right)^{1/2}\le \sqrt{\mathcal D}+\sqrt m\,\delta.\]
\begin{theorem}The finite-time coherent bound remains valid with effective radius $\sigma=\sqrt{\mathcal D/m}$ and denominator energy
\[(\sqrt{\mathcal D}+\sqrt m\delta)^2=m(\sigma+\delta)^2.\]
Its unique Haar optimizer therefore satisfies the Stage 28 stationarity equation. At the maximum certified nonlinear curvature radius, the executable calibration gives a nonempty strict low-dispersion budget.\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}The displayed inequality supplies the denominator restriction, while a target plaquette outside radius $\rho$ supplies numerator energy at least $\rho^2$. Substitution gives exactly the previously certified one-variable objective with $\eta=\sigma$.\end{proof}
The complementary event $\mathcal D>D_*$ has deterministic incident energy at least $D_*$ for every link value and hence bare exponent $D_*/(2t)$.  Converting this action charge to a normalized retained-state partition numerator is not part of the theorem.
\begin{remark}The low-dispersion result is conditional and finite. The high-dispersion measure, adaptive histories, topology, RG iteration, and mass gap remain open.\end{remark}\end{document}
